description: A published access-log record per ADR-2605310100 §3/§6 (Covenant Transparency Doctrine). R0 skeleton. Promotes the kotoba `fingerprint_middleware` audit datom (kotoba/audit/requests/v1: method/path/node_id/ts/peer_ip) and inbound-email ingest from operator-only to PUBLISHABLE for any party (member or non-member) that accessed an etzhayyim / kotoba resource. CONSTITUTIONAL: the §4 non-waivable floor applies BEFORE publication — `secretsRedacted` MUST be true; access-control material (DID private key, CACAO-as-bearer, auth tokens, session secrets, KOTOBA_* secrets) is NEVER published, only redacted. Outbound third-party data NOT brought in by ingress is out of scope (stays under tadori/danjo/himotoki gates). `ratificationStatus` MUST be `proposed-unratified` until Council Lv7+ unanimity is recorded; until then records are scaffolds and no live publication of real access occurs (§5).

accessKind.description: The ingress surface the access arrived on.

actorClass.description: Whether the accessing party is a covenant member. Both classes are subject to §3 ingress-consent.

attributedDid.description: DID of the accessing party when attributable (members are always attributable per §1; non-members usually absent).

peerIp.description: Client IP as captured by fingerprint_middleware (X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP). Present only when the proxy supplied it.

path.description: Request path (truncated as in the audit datom).

requestAuditCid.description: CID of the underlying kotoba/audit/requests/v1 datom this publication derives from.

contentDigest.description: blake3 digest of the published content (e.g. inbound-email body) for integrity, computed AFTER §4 redaction.

publishedContent.description: The publishable content of the access (e.g. inbound-email body), AFTER the §4 secret-redaction filter. Omitted if the access carried no content.

ingressConsentBasis.description: MUST be `ingress-act`: consent is constituted by the act of reaching into etzhayyim's domain (territorial / ingress consent, §3), not by membership.

secretsRedacted.description: MUST be true. Asserts the §4 floor was applied: access-control material was redacted, never published.

withheldUnderFloor.description: Categories withheld by §4 (e.g. 'credential', 'cacao-signature', 'private-key', 'outbound-third-party-pii'). Transparency about what transparency did NOT publish.

redactionMethodNoteCid.description: Open, versioned method note describing the §4 redaction filter (analogous to danjo.methodNote).

ratificationStatus.description: MUST be `proposed-unratified` at R0 (ADR-2605310100 §5). Live publication of real access requires recorded Council Lv7+ unanimity.
